regions.name: Orinoco Delta
regions.quote: This species' known range extends eastwards from the Parque Nacional Natural Tayrona in Magdalena Department, Colombia, across northern Venezuela, the Gulf of Paria and Orinoco Delta, then southwards via the Guyanas and past the mouth of the Amazon, with the southernmost records from Sergipe state in northeastern Brazil.

regions.name: Amazon
regions.quote: Although it does penetrate the lower basins of rivers, particularly the Amazon where it has been collected from the rio Xingu several hundred kilometres from its mouth, this species is predominantly an inhabitant of mangrove swamps, estuaries, and other such saline habitats.
